Empowering teachers as role models who inspire learning and character.

people.name: Syauqi Robbani, MPA
bio: Syauqi pursued his studies at Harvard University and began his career in corporate banking and investment, where he developed strong analytical and leadership foundations. He later established and managed several businesses in healthcare, education, and consumer industries. As CEO of CNA Investment and Founder of Kreativa Global School, Syauqi brings strategic vision and global perspective, connecting international standards with strong Indonesian and Islamic values to build educational institutions that inspire purpose and excellence.

people.name: Muhammad Yorga Permana, Ph.D
bio: Lecturer at the School of Business and Management, Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB), and a graduate of the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE). His expertise spans innovation, human capital management, the future of work, and organization studies.

He earned his PhD from LSE, United Kingdom, and his Master's degree from Eindhoven University of Technology, the Netherlands, both funded by the Indonesia Endowment Fund for Education (LPDP) scholarship.

Beyond academia, he serves as Expert Staff at the Ministry of Manpower and Assistant Director for Student Affairs at ITB. Passionate about education and human development, Yorga supports Kreativa Global School in fostering curiosity, collaboration, and character-driven education to nurture Indonesian talents with global competencies for an ever-evolving world of work.

initiative.title: Education Initiative
paragraphs: Kreativa Global School is a mission-driven education initiative under CNA Investment, an investment firm based in West Java with a focus on healthcare, consumer, and infrastructure sectors. CNA currently operates four hospitals and clinics, eight schools, and several other growing businesses.

CNA Investment's diverse portfolio from healthcare to education reflects its commitment to advancing human development across West Java. Kreativa Global School serves as its flagship education initiative, contributing directly to several United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):

characters.title: 7 Moslem Characters of Kreativa Learners
characters.intro: Focus on 3 Clusters: Faith and Values, Personal Development, and Social Impact

items.title: Faithful Thinker (Aqidah)
items.body: At Kreativa, faith is the foundation of knowledge — guiding learners to think critically, explore creation, and remain steadfast in tauhid.

items.title: Noble Character (Akhlaq)
items.body: Students embody integrity and adab — honesty, kindness, responsibility, and courage. They learn that true leadership begins with good manners and consistency between words and deeds.

items.title: Self Disciplined
items.body: Learners practice self-control and perseverance — mastering themselves before mastering the world. They strive for ihsan (excellence) in study, behavior, and relationships.

items.title: Curious Learner
items.body: Curiosity drives growth and innovation. Kreativa learners ask, explore, and innovate through STEM and inquiry, seeing learning as a lifelong act of worship.

items.title: Healthy & Strong Mind and Body
items.body: Active body can improve learning process and productivity. A strong body supports a strong mind. Learners stay active and balanced through movement, sports, and gratitude for health.

items.title: Organized & Responsible
items.body: Productivity requires focus and organization. In an age of digital overload, learners plan, prioritize, and stay accountable — building habits of order, responsibility, and focus.

items.title: Impactful to Community
items.body: Learners grow by giving and serving others. They help others and serve the community — living the Prophet's teaching: The best of people are those most beneficial to others.
